purpose: Track public-source status labels likely to drift across DOJ pages, court dockets, monitor sites, and city pages.
rules: A source-page label is not a final current status.
A press release is a status signal, not a court order unless it attaches or points to one.
Closed/enforcement/investigation labels must be timestamped and source-scoped.
Status display should prefer the latest court order when a court order governs the decree or case.
